title: Console sidebar at 1280 px: the first frame draws the full 256 px sidebar over the content, then animates to the 48 px rail
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ③ ruling-directed. Ruling B on #26676 (6520722066, maintainer 「你可以自主验收合并，有问题会开新卡」) fixes a new card under #26676 as the remedy for a finding after a landing. Found by the post-merge proxy preview review of PR #27893 (#27593): comment 6521834471, on `main` `18318361`, `examples/app-crm`, evidence branch `claude/issue-27593-proxy-evidence` @ `e1844a1f` (`evidence/27593-proxy/`). The v4 boards do not draw the narrow-window sidebar, so "expected" comes from #27593's Acceptance and the seat's request 6514234395. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason
Who: every console reader on a laptop-width window (below 1416 px). What happens: each load can flash a wide sidebar over the page before it folds, so the content jumps and the first click can land on the sidebar.

## Observed
- Expected (#27593 Acceptance 1): at 1280 px the first frame is already the 48 px icon rail.
- On `main`, when the saved sidebar state is expanded, the first frame draws the sidebar at 256 px over the content. Then it animates down to 48 px within about 150–450 ms. Three cases do this: a first visit, a load on a narrow window after the sidebar was expanded on a wide one, and a reload while the sidebar is shown as an overlay.
- Surface: console shell sidebar, 1280 px, Contacts list.

## Wanted
The rail-or-full decision is made before the first paint, from the window width and the kept preference, so the sidebar never shows an expanded first frame and then collapses.

## Acceptance
- [ ] At 1280 px, in all three cases above, every frame from the first one shows the 48 px rail. Pinned by a test that reads the first rendered state.
- [ ] At 1440 px, nothing changes.
